consequence.statement: Kubelet configuration becomes available on the EC2NodeClass v1 API; the release note states no failure, removal or behavior change, so an operator who does nothing is unaffected.
consequence.remediation: No action required; the kubelet configuration is a newly available optional capability on the EC2NodeClass v1 API.
